outcome: Blood DNA methylation in early childhood
cohort: The study participants included 9833 term newborns from 19 pregnancy cohorts and 2429 children aged 6 to 10 years from 6 pediatric cohorts.
finding: Six specific CpGs in cord blood (MAP2K2, LIM2, CNP, BLM, RASA3, RUNX3) were associated with cesarean delivery, an association that did not persist into childhood, where no CpGs were identified.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with specific cord blood DNA methylation sites and cell proportions at birth, but these associations did not persist into early childhood.
followup_time: Up to 6 to 10 years after birth
